scope: Completed live online source discovery on 762 NCT identifiers; save exact NCT registry detail via /api/phase3-live-registry-backfill. Source leads do not constitute clinical endpoint adjudication.

fda.interpretation: Brand or sponsor name match does not establish exact trial NDA/PDUFA status

aact.interpretation: Registry mirror database accessible upon separate account setup

warnings: Published registry results and statistical-analysis tables are not equivalent to a verified clinical PASS.
Exact NCT mentions in PubMed articles and SEC filings require document-level scientific interpretation.
FDA approval and CRLs are indexed by drug/application, not reliably by NCT alone.
AACT, CTIS and WHO were tested for access; bulk automated verified mapping was not completed for them.
Findings may overlap across sources, and a missing source hit does not prove evidence absent.
notes: Full harvest was executed in the remote sandbox; this GitHub file stores reconciled coverage counts, not all raw source documents.
